purpose: Qualitative coding schema to strictly separate raw user observation from derived interpretation and product decision

coding_levels.definition: Verbatim transcript, click timestamp, physical eye gaze, or exact UI interaction with zero inferential judgment.
coding_levels.example: User paused 8 seconds on footer, selected NIT text, and copied it to clipboard.

coding_levels.definition: Direct behavioral inference grounded in the observation and think-aloud utterance.
coding_levels.example: User sought external verification of the foundation's legal registration number.

coding_levels.definition: Causal explanation of the observed friction or enablement.
coding_levels.example: Displaying the NIT in the footer satisfies the initial legitimacy check for high-skepticism donors.

coding_levels.definition: Actionable engineering or content requirement authorized strictly by accumulated evidence.
coding_levels.example: Keep NIT and Chamber of Commerce registration in persistent footer with one-click copy button.
